sentence: Settles a weekend plan by randomly drawing one of two fixed options for each open slot (Saturday morning, Saturday night, Sunday), with Friday night already set.
use_when: A group can't decide between two options for each part of a weekend and wants chance to choose
Someone wants a quick random pick for several plan slots at once
A group wants to leave a tie-breaking decision to a draw that everyone can see
dont_use_when: People want to vote on options and count preferences
The options or slots need to be different from the fixed weekend plan
A full tournament bracket with rounds and matchups is needed
